_comment: TEMPLATE. Every value below is a placeholder (null, 'PENDING', or an example) and must be replaced by the execution runner at the moment this protocol actually runs, not before. Mirrors the two-layer discipline of src/muru/paper_benchmark/rc5_manifest.py, reduced to one layer because this protocol runs zero new search: there is no partition-execution layer distinct from the global-plan layer, only a single re-scoring pass against an already-sealed E2a manifest.
write_once_rule: written immediately before section-4 gate evaluation begins; never appended to or amended after. A re-run is a NEW manifest with a new manifest_id, never an edit of this one.

protocol.digest_convention: sha256 over the canonical (sorted-key, no-whitespace) JSON serialization of MURU_V2_RETENTION_REMEDIATION_PROTOCOL.json, exactly as rc5_manifest.py's own digest convention requires -- stated here so a verifier hashing raw bytes does not raise a false tamper alarm

committed_before_e2a_seal.claim: this manifest's protocol block digest must match a commit that predates the e2a_source.sealed_at_utc timestamp below. If it does not, this protocol was not results-blind and must not be treated as a valid pre-registration.

e2a_source.description: the sealed E2a Pareto data this protocol's implementation will consume. Populated only by an independent read of E2a's OWN manifest -- this template's author never opened it.
e2a_source.retention_identity_regression_status: PENDING (must be PASS before this protocol may consume any record; see e2_preflight.py)
e2a_source.e2b_rows_present: PENDING (must be false, or must be filtered before ingestion; see input contract admissibility_requirement)

environment_lock.description: host/environment facts specific to THIS run of the re-scoring pass. No scientific field belongs here -- every scientific field is a pure function of (protocol, e2a_source), never chosen at this layer, mirroring rc5_manifest.py's own binding-derivation clause.
environment_lock.git_commit: PENDING (git rev-parse HEAD^{}, never the tag form)

gate_evaluation_result.description: populated the moment section 4's gate fires; determines whether the remainder of this manifest is ever completed

dev_selection_result.description: populated only if execution_status != DOES_NOT_EXECUTE. One entry per constant-bearing policy family.

bootstrap_seeds.description: one entry per non-control policy, derived per MURU_V2_RETENTION_REMEDIATION_PROTOCOL.json statistics.bootstrap_seed_construction

adoption_decision_summary.description: populated only after every policy_summary on V2C_RET_EVAL is complete; must match analysis output's adoption_decision record exactly

static_checks_passed.description: boolean per structural control this protocol declares (section 9 of the preregistration); a manifest with any false value here is not a valid completion record
